name: awakened tree
desc: An awakened tree is an ordinary tree given sentience and mobility by the awaken spell or similar magic.
languages: one language known by its creator

special_abilities.name: false appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

actions.name: slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

lore:
The Awakened Tree, or *Arbor Vigilans*, dwells within the deepest, most primeval reaches of the world, where the soil is thick with the residue of ancient sorcery. To the untrained eye, they appear as majestic, gnarled oaks or towering pines, yet they possess a slow, deliberate consciousness.

Their predation is a study in patience. They do not pursue; they wait. By offering a cool reprieve from the sun or a bounty of unnaturally sweet fruit, they lure the unwary into the reach of their boughs. Once positioned, the tree strikes with crushing weight, its roots surging from the earth like wooden serpents to drag the broken remains into the loam, nourishing the grove with the blood of the interloper.

Peasant lore speaks of the "Walking Bark," guardians bound by the vows of long-dead druids. It is said that when a forest weeps, the trees find their feet. Loggers tell tales of groves that shift positions overnight—a silent warning that some borders are not meant to be crossed. To walk among them is to be a guest in a house that might, at any moment, decide to collapse upon you.
